issue_context.title: Support optional comments access from plugin transform
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature

While I would not expect this is general usecase, it is sometimes inevitably plugin's transform would like to access comment from original `Program`. https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/4114 would be an example, where comments serve as directives to the instrumentation. There are possibly other cases, as it is quite common to use comments as directives in JS ecosystem. 

Comments are detached from AST, so it doesn't come together when transform fn receives `Program`. Still, host's plugin runner have access to reference to the comments already can pass into plugin. The main challenge here is let plugin access those lazily enough, instead of eagerly serialize & copy over to plugin's memory space. 

Due to current design of how we store comments, we can't directly attach it into some sort of global storage (tls) or attach into HostEnvironment for the wasm (https://github.com/wasmerio/wasmer/discussions/2830). The end goal is plugin access same interface to the host (`impl Comment`) and it serves as proxy to pass / mutate comments to the host without serialize & copy over whole.
